art_direction: 上眼缘局部回笔加粗，略高低的双眼望右，短眉平缓，无嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Set down two shallow pen arcs, then return over only the middle third of each upper lid. The second pass may miss the first by a hair, leaving one intentional doubled section. Keep the lower edges as short separate marks. Both pupils turn right; the right eye sits a fraction higher. Leave an uneven paper slit in each dark pupil. Add two short, low brows. No mouth, lashes, or repeated hatching.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: inspected: preview checked by the root agent; retained as a user-rejected style experiment after the task changed to a new avatar collection; do not count as an accepted final image
visual_review_before_rejection: passed: compressed preview inspected for economical distinct hand-drawn contours, broad dark pupils with irregular paper reserves, single flat color, coordinated gaze, pale paper, no text or watermark
batch_status: user rejected; stopped after change of creative direction; no further generation in this series
